<subject>Re: Any Plans tonight?</subject>
<body>
Hey Shaun!  Sorry I didn't get back with you Friday.  I left a little early, so I must have just missed your message.  Did you guys have a good time on Friday night?  How is everything going?

It has actually been thick around here.  Worked several late nights last week to try and get caught up on the Treasury reconciliation backlog.  We're in the middle of the quarterly audit prep and it's been relentless.  I may have to delay the purchase of the new car with Halcyon's share price taking a hit lately.  It did gain some points on Friday and early today.  Hopefully it keeps it up.

The Corporate Lending team has been pushing hard on the commercial portfolio reviews, and Credit Risk wants everything signed off before the end of month. I've been coordinating with the regional offices to ensure all documentation is in order. It's been a bit mad, to be honest.

Talked to Max since his wedding?  Haven't heard anything out of him since.  Probably just overcome by marital bliss.  His new wife seemed lovely from what I gathered.  Would be good to catch up with him properly once things settle down here.

Anyway, thanks again for the invite to Gilians on Friday - sounds like it would have been a good night out.  Next time I'll try to make it work.  Give my regards to your brother-in-law and the others.

Cheers,
Clifford
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Palmer, Shaun <shaun.palmer@halcyonbank.co.uk>
Sent: 22 March 2024 15:18
To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk
Subject: Any Plans tonight?

Hey, what's going on?  My brother-in-law and a friend of his are flying into town tonight?  We're going to head over to Gilians (sp?), a place that is supposed to be like The Ivy. We'll prob get there at about 10:00.  We thought we'd hang there for a while and then head to the city centre and find some kind of bar.  A couple of other friends of mine from B-school will be joining us, I thought you might want to as well.  Are you game?

Write back or give me a call H: +44 7244 382092, cell: +44 20 2529 2161. I'm leaving work in a few minutes if I don't respond to any email.

later,
Shaun

-----Original Message-----
From: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk
Sent: 26 February 2024 13:39
To: Shaun Palmer
Subject: Re: Hotel Booking

Shaun,  Thanks for taking care of that.   I will probably be getting into Manchester earlier than you.  I'll have my mobile with me.  +44 7047 822161. If you get into town earlier, give me a call.  Otherwise why don't you just call me at the room when you get to the hotel.   Sounds great, we'll ride over together.  I might bring this girl I have kinda been seeing with me. My latest victim.  We'll see.    I believe that's correct.  The wedding is at 7.

Thanks for the Travelodge tip.  I was going to ask about that.

Clifford

-----Original Message-----
From: Shaun Palmer <shaun.palmer@halcyonbank.co.uk>
Sent: 26 February 2024 12:09
To: clifford.jones@halcyonbank.co.uk
Subject: 2nd Hotel Room

Clifford,

Good news - we were able to get the second room at the same £99 rate. Below you'll see two separate confirmation numbers - I don't think it matters which one you or I use.  When you check in, just claim one of them. They're both on my card so you can transfer to yours at check-in.

I'm not sure what time we'll get there since we'll be coming from Birmingham.  I estimate we'll get there at about 5:00 (the wedding is at 7:00 right?) We'll actually be travelling to Birmingham on Friday since some of Hillary's family from the Midlands will be there as well.

If we're not in contact before then, let's just plan on meeting at the hotel sometime between 6:00 and 6:30.  We can drive over to the wedding together from there.

In case you didn't know, they're registered at John Lewis - we got him a gift yesterday, still plenty of items on the list.

Shaun
